description:
Wire ExtensionRunner hooks into the compaction flow, matching pi-mono's
session_before_compact and session_compact extension events.

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts lines 530-544.
Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts lines 1650-1700 (manual),
           1880-1960 (auto).

Depends on: ExtensionRunner ticket, manual compaction ticket.

## session_before_compact hook

Emitted BEFORE any compaction begins (both manual via Session.compact/1 and
auto-compaction triggered by the Loop).

Event type: :session_before_compact
Payload:
  %{
    preparation: %{messages_to_summarize: [...], first_kept_entry_id: ..., tokens_before: ...},
    signal: abort_ref
  }

Allowed results:
  :ok                                  — proceed normally
  {:cancel, reason}                    — abort compaction; emit CompactionEnd{aborted?: true}
  {:ok, %{compaction: custom_result}}  — extension provides its own CompactionResult map
                                         (%{summary, first_kept_entry_id, tokens_before});
                                         skip the Compaction.compact/3 LLM call entirely

## session_compact hook

Emitted AFTER compaction completes and the CompactionEntry has been appended.

Event type: :session_compact
Payload:
  %{
    compaction_entry: %SessionEntry.CompactionEntry{},
    from_extension: boolean()   # true when session_before_compact provided a custom result
  }

Return value: ignored (notification only).

## Where to wire

In Session.compact GenServer handler (manual path), BEFORE calling Compaction.compact/3:
  1. Call Compaction.prepare/2 to get the preparation map.
  2. Call Session.emit_hook(session, :session_before_compact, %{preparation: ..., signal: ...}).
  3. If {:cancelled, _}: emit CompactionEnd{aborted?: true}; return.
  4. If {:modified, %{compaction: custom_result}}: skip LLM call, use custom_result directly
     with from_hook: true in append_compaction.
  5. Otherwise: proceed with Compaction.compact/3.
  After appending CompactionEntry: call emit_hook(:session_compact, %{...}).

Apply identical wiring in handle_overflow/6 in loop.ex (auto-compaction path).

## Tests

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/compaction_extensions_test.exs.
Port from tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/compaction-extensions.test.ts.
Cover:
  - session_before_compact with {:cancel, reason} prevents compaction and emits
    CompactionEnd{aborted?: true}
  - session_before_compact with {:ok, %{compaction: custom}} skips LLM call,
    uses provided summary, sets from_hook?: true on CompactionEntry
  - session_compact fires after successful compaction with correct entry
  - session_compact fires after extension-provided compaction with from_extension: true
